subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers wait for the requested live Socket Mode envelope/log proof before authorizing a fix, or sponsor a live Slack reproduction themselves?
rationale: Current source inspection shows several plausible boundaries, and choosing one without live envelope proof could patch the wrong layer.

options.title: Wait for reporter proof
options.body: Keep the issue open and require the requested redacted current-main or newest-release envelope fields plus Gateway logs before queueing code work.

options.title: Sponsor live Slack repro
options.body: A maintainer can reproduce in a controlled Slack workspace and provide the missing envelope/filter/authorization evidence directly.

options.title: Close later if evidence never arrives
options.body: If no current live proof appears after a reasonable maintainer-defined window, close as insufficient evidence and ask for a fresh report with the requested diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Wait for reporter proof
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require the requested redacted current-main or newest-release envelope fields plus Gateway logs before queueing code work.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned and already asked for the exact live proof needed to choose the repair boundary.
